_comment: What Cabal Hunter has watched. Read off the production box on 2026-09-05 at
22:55 UTC, out of the creator index radar-creator-index.timer had just
rebuilt, plus the band figures from docs/research/data/0024-base-rates.json.
The population block is the index's own `population` object, copied field
for field rather than re-summed here -- the index computes it while it walks
the store, and a second sum over the same file would be a second answer to
get wrong. `creators` is the number of keys in its `creators` map. The band
block below is unchanged: 0024 has not been re-run, and copying a fresh date
onto a stale measurement is the one edit this file must never carry.
COUNTS, NOT SHARES, and that is deliberate. Every share on the site is
derived in one place -- honesty.ts -- out of `measured`, never out of
`launches`. The gap between those two is Cabal Hunter's own outcome backlog,
and dividing by the wrong one folds that lag into a claim about the venue.
The Rust side makes the same choice in radar-roast's Population::share, and
a second copy of the arithmetic here would be a second copy to get wrong.
This file is the fallback. In production the same shape arrives from
/v1/public/stats and is fresher; when that call fails the page shows this
and says when it was measured. It never shows a figure without its date.
EVERY NUMBER HERE HAS A DATE ON IT AND IS EXPECTED TO MOVE.
